The set’s been sitting in storage for the last 25+ years, packed away back in ’98 when I put my MTG stuff away.</p><p>I’m an old gamer slowly selling off some of my toys and clearing out storage—before my wife ends up having to figure out what to do with all these treasures.</p><p>If you’ve got any questions, or just want to swap stories about the good ol’ MTG days, feel free to message me.</p><p><strong>(Answers to a few common questions below)</strong></p><p>• The card is stored in a penny sleeve, top loader, and storage case.
